contribution.position: Green tests (412 passed, 87% coverage) and in-budget p99 look reassuring, but both sev2 incidents last quarter came from retry storms — a failure mode neither unit tests nor the perf report exercises. Before this change ships, we need evidence the retry-storm failure mode is not regressed (e.g., a chaos/load test of retry behavior under downstream failure), since the current artifacts cannot speak to it.
